front.title: JSCalendar: Converting from and to iCalendar

abstract.t: This document defines how to convert calendaring information between the JSCalendar and iCalendar data formats. It considers every JSCalendar and iCalendar element registered at IANA at the time of publication, and defines conversion rules for all elements that are common to both formats. It updates the semantics of some iCalendar elements to align with JSCalendar, and extends both formats to support converting arbitrary or unknown JSCalendar and iCalendar elements. This document updates RFC 5545 ("iCalendar") and its extensions RFC 7986 and RFC 9073.
